explanation: A sign or transmission that conveys information.
h1: 山里的手机信号很弱。
e1: The phone signal is weak in the mountains.
h2: 绿灯是可以通行的信号。
e2: A green light is a signal to proceed.

explanation: Enter details to create an account or membership.
h1: 注册前请阅读使用说明。
e1: Read the instructions before signing up.
h2: 我用邮箱注册了学习账号。
e2: I used my email to register a study account.

explanation: Transmit a message, file or other information.
h1: 照片太大，暂时无法发送。
e1: The photo is too large to send right now.
h2: 老师把作业发送到了班级群。
e2: The teacher sent the homework to the class group.

explanation: Spend approved time away from work.
h1: 她休假期间去了海边。
e1: She visited the seaside while on leave.
h2: 经理下周休假，由同事接替工作。
e2: The manager is on leave next week; a colleague will cover.

explanation: Take a photo quickly without arranging the subject.
h1: 这张照片是她跑步时抓拍的。
e1: This photo was captured while she was running.
h2: 记者抓拍到了孩子的笑脸。
e2: The reporter captured a child's smiling face.

explanation: Make another version of text, a file or an object.
h1: 请复制这段文字到文档里。
e1: Copy this passage into the document.
h2: 重要文件可以复制到另一块硬盘。
e2: Important files can be copied to another hard drive.

explanation: Stop an activity or connection before it finishes.
h1: 网络故障中断了视频会议。
e1: A network fault interrupted the video meeting.
h2: 讨论被敲门声中断了。
e2: A knock at the door interrupted the discussion.

explanation: Bring together the main points or lessons learned.
h1: 请用三句话总结这篇文章。
e1: Summarize this article in three sentences.
h2: 比赛结束后，队员一起总结经验。
e2: After the match, the players reviewed what they had learned.

explanation: A device used for long-term computer storage.
h1: 这块硬盘存着很多旧照片。
e1: This hard drive stores many old photos.
h2: 电脑的硬盘坏了，文件读不出来。
e2: The computer's hard drive failed, so the files cannot be read.

explanation: A numerical result in an exam or competition.
h1: 老师没有公布每个人的分数。
e1: The teacher did not announce everyone's score.
h2: 这次比赛的分数比上次高。
e2: The score in this competition is higher than last time.

explanation: Supply electrical energy to a rechargeable battery.
h1: 手机没电了，我正在充电。
e1: My phone is flat, so I am charging it.
h2: 这盏台灯充电后可以用一整晚。
e2: This lamp can last all evening after being charged.

explanation: Ask permission to be absent from school or work.
h1: 她发烧了，向老师请假。
e1: She has a fever and asked her teacher for leave.
h2: 明天有家事，我需要请假一天。
e2: I have a family matter tomorrow and need a day off.

explanation: Send a written reply to an earlier message.
h1: 收到你的信后，我马上回信。
e1: I wrote back as soon as I received your letter.
h2: 爷爷还没有回信，我有点担心。
e2: Grandfather has not written back, so I am a little worried.

explanation: A single page of content on the internet.
h1: 这个网页上有课程安排。
e1: The course schedule is on this web page.
h2: 网页一直打不开，可能是网络问题。
e2: The page will not open; it may be a network problem.

explanation: A language other than one's native language.
h1: 她正在学习第二门外语。
e1: She is learning a second foreign language.
h2: 这份说明书有几种外语版本。
e2: These instructions are available in several foreign languages.

explanation: A screen that displays computer output.
h1: 这台显示器比旧的清楚。
e1: This monitor is clearer than the old one.
h2: 请把显示器调低一点，眼睛更舒服。
e2: Lower the monitor a little to make viewing more comfortable.

explanation: A numbered or named part of a longer text.
h1: 本书最后一个章节讲学习方法。
e1: The last chapter discusses study methods.
h2: 我们按章节整理了阅读笔记。
e2: We organized our reading notes by chapter.

explanation: A control pressed to operate a device.
h1: 遥控器上的按键有点松。
e1: A button on the remote control is loose.
h2: 请不要同时按下两个按键。
e2: Do not press two keys at the same time.

explanation: The final part of a calendar year.
h1: 我们年底会整理一次旧照片。
e1: We sort our old photos at the end of the year.
h2: 这座图书馆预计年底开放。
e2: This library is expected to open at the end of the year.

explanation: Written content considered as words rather than images.
h1: 这个工具可以从图片中提取文本。
e1: This tool can extract text from images.
h2: 请把文本改成更容易读的句子。
e2: Rewrite the text using sentences that are easier to read.

explanation: The short interval between two lessons.
h1: 课间我们到走廊透透气。
e1: We get some fresh air in the corridor between classes.
h2: 请利用课间准备好下节课的书。
e2: Use the break to get the books for the next lesson ready.

explanation: A classmate who shares or sits beside one's desk.
h1: 同桌借给我一块橡皮。
e1: My desk mate lent me an eraser.
h2: 我和同桌一起检查答案。
e2: My desk mate and I checked our answers together.

explanation: The place where an examination is held.
h1: 进入考场前请关掉手机。
e1: Turn off your phone before entering the exam room.
h2: 准考证上写着考场的位置。
e2: The exam admission card shows the exam venue.

english: fail to meet the passing mark
explanation: Receive a result below the required standard.
h1: 他这次考试不及格，需要补考。
e1: He failed this exam and needs to retake it.
h2: 作业漏做太多，成绩可能不及格。
e2: Too much homework is missing, so the grade may be a fail.

explanation: A short message sent through a mobile phone service.
h1: 我收到一条提醒上课的短信。
e1: I received a text reminding me about class.
h2: 验证码短信还没有到。
e2: The verification text has not arrived yet.

explanation: Maintain social contact with other people.
h1: 她喜欢和不同年龄的人交往。
e1: She enjoys interacting with people of different ages.
h2: 与邻居交往时要尊重彼此的习惯。
e2: Respect each other's habits when interacting with neighbors.

explanation: Inner feelings that connect people to experiences or others.
h1: 这篇文章表达了对家乡的情感。
e1: This article expresses feelings for the writer's hometown.
h2: 音乐能帮助人们表达情感。
e2: Music can help people express their emotions.

explanation: Something a device or service is designed to do.
h1: 这个软件增加了录音功能。
e1: This software added a recording function.
h2: 我最常用的是提醒功能。
e2: The reminder function is the one I use most.

explanation: A small camera built into or connected to a device.
h1: 视频开始前，请检查摄像头。
e1: Check the webcam before the video starts.
h2: 门口的摄像头只拍公共区域。
e2: The camera by the door records only the public area.

explanation: Select and join sections of a recording.
h1: 我把采访录音剪接成了一个短片。
e1: I edited the interview recording into a short film.
h2: 剪接时不要改变说话人的原意。
e2: Do not change the speaker's meaning when editing.

explanation: Capture sound for later listening.
h1: 这段录音里有老师的发音示范。
e1: This recording contains the teacher's pronunciation examples.
h2: 录音前要征得在场人的同意。
e2: Get permission from those present before recording.

explanation: A telephone call received by a phone.
h1: 我开会时没有注意到来电。
e1: I did not notice the incoming call during the meeting.
h2: 手机上显示了三次未接来电。
e2: The phone shows three missed calls.

explanation: Stop temporarily with the possibility of continuing.
h1: 请暂停视频，我想记下这句话。
e1: Pause the video; I want to write down this sentence.
h2: 雨太大，比赛只能暂停。
e2: The rain was so heavy that the match had to pause.

explanation: The exchange of messages through communication systems.
h1: 山区的通讯条件改善了很多。
e1: Communications in the mountains have improved greatly.
h2: 这台设备用于应急通讯。
e2: This device is used for emergency communications.

explanation: Take in a message, signal or transmitted file.
h1: 电脑正在接收老师发来的文件。
e1: The computer is receiving the file sent by the teacher.
h2: 这台收音机能接收本地节目。
e2: This radio can receive local programs.

explanation: A device that picks up sound for amplification or recording.
h1: 说话时请靠近麦克风。
e1: Move closer to the microphone when speaking.
h2: 麦克风关着，大家听不见你的声音。
e2: The microphone is off, so nobody can hear you.

explanation: A short assessment of knowledge or ability.
h1: 明天有一个听力测验。
e1: There is a listening quiz tomorrow.
h2: 这次测验不计入总成绩。
e2: This quiz does not count toward the final grade.

explanation: How much of a planned activity has been completed.
h1: 我们按周检查学习进度。
e1: We check our study progress each week.
h2: 下雨影响了修路的进度。
e2: Rain affected the progress of the road repairs.

explanation: Operating without a physical connecting wire.
h1: 这副无线耳机需要先充电。
e1: These wireless earphones need charging first.
h2: 会议室提供无线网络。
e2: The meeting room provides a wireless network.

explanation: A place or account used to receive mail.
h1: 请把课程资料发到我的邮箱。
e1: Send the course materials to my email inbox.
h2: 我每天早上检查一次邮箱。
e2: I check my inbox every morning.

explanation: Stop a device by turning its power off.
h1: 离开前请给电脑关机。
e1: Shut down the computer before leaving.
h2: 手机关机后就收不到电话了。
e2: The phone cannot receive calls once it is switched off.

explanation: Enter an account to access a service.
h1: 输入密码后就可以登录。
e1: You can log in after entering the password.
h2: 我换了手机，需要重新登录。
e2: I changed phones and need to log in again.

explanation: The most important parts of a topic.
h1: 老师把要点写在黑板上。
e1: The teacher wrote the main points on the board.
h2: 请先告诉我报告的要点。
e2: Tell me the main points of the report first.

explanation: Reach the required passing standard.
h1: 这次考试要六十分才能及格。
e1: You need sixty points to pass this exam.
h2: 只求及格还不够，要弄懂错题。
e2: Passing alone is not enough; understand the mistakes.

explanation: Recorded sound and moving images considered together.
h1: 图书馆有专门的音像资料室。
e1: The library has a room for audio and video materials.
h2: 这些音像资料记录了村里的旧习俗。
e2: These recordings document the village's old customs.

explanation: How loud a sound is played or produced.
h1: 夜里看视频时把音量调小。
e1: Turn the volume down when watching videos at night.
h2: 音量太低，我听不清老师的话。
e2: The volume is too low for me to hear the teacher clearly.

explanation: A container used to organize papers or computer files.
h1: 我把照片放进同一个文件夹。
e1: I put the photos into one folder.
h2: 请在文件夹上写清楚课程名称。
e2: Write the course name clearly on the folder.

explanation: Sound recorded or transmitted electronically.
h1: 这节课同时提供文字和音频。
e1: This lesson provides both text and audio.
h2: 下载的音频可以离线播放。
e2: The downloaded audio can be played offline.

explanation: The key or action used to confirm input or start a new line.
h1: 输完名字后按回车。
e1: Press Enter after typing your name.
h2: 这里按回车会换行，不会发送消息。
e2: Here, Enter starts a new line rather than sending the message.

explanation: Begin attending classes in a new school term.
h1: 开学前我把课本包好了。
e1: I covered my textbooks before the term started.
h2: 开学第一天，老师介绍了新同学。
e2: On the first day of term, the teacher introduced the new classmate.

explanation: Turn on a machine or electronic device.
h1: 电脑开机以后，请先检查网络。
e1: Check the network after the computer starts.
h2: 这台旧手机开机比较慢。
e2: This old phone takes a while to switch on.

explanation: Return something to its original or previous condition.
h1: 我把误改的设置还原了。
e1: I restored the settings I had changed by mistake.
h2: 根据照片，可以还原房间原来的样子。
e2: The photos can help reconstruct the room's original appearance.

explanation: The punctuation mark that ends a statement.
h1: 这个句子最后要加句号。
e1: Put a full stop at the end of this sentence.
h2: 你把逗号写成了句号。
e2: You wrote a full stop instead of a comma.

explanation: A device that converts paper documents into digital images.
h1: 扫描仪放在打印机旁边。
e1: The scanner is beside the printer.
h2: 旧照片可以用扫描仪保存下来。
e2: Old photos can be preserved using a scanner.

explanation: Keep information so it can be retrieved later.
h1: 这张卡可以存储很多照片。
e1: This card can store many photos.
h2: 录音会存储在手机里。
e2: The recording will be stored on the phone.

explanation: The highest possible score in an assessment.
h1: 她听写得了满分。
e1: She got full marks in dictation.
h2: 这道题的满分是十分。
e2: This question is worth a maximum of ten points.

explanation: Connected to or available through the internet.
h1: 我晚上八点会在线。
e1: I will be online at eight tonight.
h2: 这门课可以在线学习。
e2: This course can be studied online.

explanation: A machine that makes paper copies of documents.
h1: 复印机里没有纸了。
e1: The photocopier has run out of paper.
h2: 这台复印机可以把两面都印出来。
e2: This photocopier can copy both sides.

explanation: Produce or send information from a system.
h1: 请把结果输出到一个文件里。
e1: Output the results to a file.
h2: 这个接口只能输出声音。
e2: This port can only output sound.

explanation: A person listed for communication or coordination.
h1: 我把老师添加为联系人。
e1: I added the teacher as a contact.
h2: 表格上需要填写紧急联系人。
e2: The form requires an emergency contact.

explanation: Record one's arrival or attendance.
h1: 参加活动前请先签到。
e1: Sign in before joining the activity.
h2: 签到表放在门口的桌上。
e2: The sign-in sheet is on the table by the door.

explanation: A piece of writing prepared by a student.
h1: 这篇作文写的是一次旅行。
e1: This composition is about a trip.
h2: 老师建议我的作文增加具体细节。
e2: The teacher suggested adding concrete details to my essay.

explanation: A machine that produces paper copies from digital files.
h1: 打印机的墨水快用完了。
e1: The printer is nearly out of ink.
h2: 请在打印机旁取你的资料。
e2: Collect your documents beside the printer.

explanation: A device used to recharge a battery.
h1: 我忘了带手机充电器。
e1: I forgot to bring my phone charger.
h2: 这两个充电器不能混用。
e2: These two chargers cannot be used interchangeably.

explanation: Separate a connection between two things.
h1: 不用时可以断开电源。
e1: Disconnect the power when it is not in use.
h2: 手机和耳机的连接突然断开了。
e2: The connection between the phone and earphones suddenly dropped.

explanation: Formally remove a registration or account.
h1: 不用的账号可以申请注销。
e1: You can request closure of an unused account.
h2: 注销之前请保存需要的资料。
e2: Save the materials you need before closing the account.

explanation: Handle both incoming and outgoing messages or materials.
h1: 这个软件可以收发邮件。
e1: This software can send and receive email.
h2: 办公室安排专人收发文件。
e2: The office assigned someone to handle incoming and outgoing documents.

explanation: The address used to open a website or page.
h1: 请确认网址没有拼错。
e1: Check that the web address is spelled correctly.
h2: 老师把学习网址写在黑板上。
e2: The teacher wrote the study website address on the board.

explanation: A setting that stops a device from producing sound.
h1: 上课前请把手机设为静音。
e1: Set your phone to silent mode before class.
h2: 我忘了取消静音，所以没听见来电。
e2: I forgot to turn off silent mode and missed the call.

explanation: A flat disc that stores digital information.
h1: 这张光盘里保存着旧照片。
e1: This disc contains old photos.
h2: 老师用光盘播放听力材料。
e2: The teacher played listening materials from a disc.

explanation: The amount of data transmitted over a connection.
h1: 我的手机流量快用完了。
e1: My mobile data allowance is nearly used up.
h2: 使用无线网络可以节省流量。
e2: Using a wireless network can save mobile data.

explanation: Storage used by a computer while programs are running.
h1: 同时打开太多程序会占用内存。
e1: Opening too many programs uses up memory.
h2: 这台电脑增加内存后运行更顺畅。
e2: This computer runs more smoothly after a memory upgrade.

explanation: Connect a device to the internet or another network.
h1: 这台电脑还没有联网。
e1: This computer is not connected to a network yet.
h2: 设备联网后会自动更新时间。
e2: The device updates its time automatically after connecting.

explanation: An image used as a device screen background.
h1: 她把猫的照片设成手机壁纸。
e1: She set a photo of her cat as her phone wallpaper.
h2: 这张壁纸太亮，看字不方便。
e2: This wallpaper is too bright for comfortable reading.

explanation: The paper containing examination questions.
h1: 请在考卷上写清楚姓名。
e1: Write your name clearly on the exam paper.
h2: 老师发回考卷，让我们改正错误。
e2: The teacher returned the exam papers so we could correct mistakes.

explanation: A meeting held repeatedly on a fixed schedule.
h1: 我们每周一开一次例会。
e1: We hold a regular meeting every Monday.
h2: 今天的例会改到下午了。
e2: Today's regular meeting has moved to the afternoon.

explanation: Respond to questions about a thesis or academic project.
h1: 她正在准备毕业答辩。
e1: She is preparing for her graduation defense.
h2: 答辩时要说明研究方法。
e2: Explain the research methods during the defense.

explanation: The name used to identify an account.
h1: 用户名不能和密码相同。
e1: The username must not be the same as the password.
h2: 我忘了用户名，只记得注册邮箱。
e2: I forgot my username but remember the registration email.

explanation: A handheld device used to control a computer pointer.
h1: 鼠标放在键盘右边。
e1: The mouse is to the right of the keyboard.
h2: 这只鼠标的滚轮坏了。
e2: The scroll wheel on this mouse is broken.

explanation: A blank position separating words or input items.
h1: 两个词之间需要一个空格。
e1: A space is needed between the two words.
h2: 密码里不要多打一个空格。
e2: Do not type an extra space in the password.

explanation: The visible controls through which a user operates software.
h1: 这个界面上的文字太小了。
e1: The text on this interface is too small.
h2: 更新后，登录界面有了新布局。
e2: The login interface has a new layout after the update.

explanation: A punctuation mark separating parts of a sentence.
h1: 这里应该用逗号，不是句号。
e1: Use a comma here, not a full stop.
h2: 请给这句话加上合适的逗号。
e2: Add appropriate commas to this sentence.

explanation: The school subject covering Chinese reading and writing.
h1: 今天的语文课练习写日记。
e1: Today's Chinese class practices diary writing.
h2: 她把语文书留在学校了。
e2: She left her Chinese textbook at school.

explanation: A card showing a person's identity as an employee.
h1: 进入办公楼需要出示工作证。
e1: Show your employee card to enter the office building.
h2: 他的工作证挂在胸前。
e2: His employee identification card hangs on his chest.

explanation: The part of a task or topic that is hardest to understand.
h1: 老师解释了这道题的难点。
e1: The teacher explained the difficult part of this problem.
h2: 发音是他学习中文的一个难点。
e2: Pronunciation is one of his difficulties in learning Chinese.

explanation: Temporary stored data used to speed up access.
h1: 清理缓存后，网页恢复正常。
e1: The web page worked normally after the cache was cleared.
h2: 这个软件的缓存占了很多空间。
e2: This software's cache takes up a lot of space.

explanation: A completed paper containing answers to examination questions.
h1: 交答卷前请再检查一遍。
e1: Check your answer sheet once more before handing it in.
h2: 监考老师按顺序收答卷。
e2: The invigilator collected the answer sheets in order.

explanation: Marks that organize and clarify written sentences.
h1: 这段话的标点需要修改。
e1: The punctuation in this passage needs revision.
h2: 写作文时不要漏掉标点。
e2: Do not leave out punctuation when writing a composition.

explanation: Start a device or process again.
h1: 电脑卡住了，我准备重启。
e1: The computer has frozen, so I am going to restart it.
h2: 重启之前先保存文档。
e2: Save the document before restarting.

explanation: Study material before it is taught in class.
h1: 今晚先预习明天的课文。
e1: Preview tomorrow's text tonight.
h2: 预习时可以把不懂的词圈出来。
e2: Circle unfamiliar words while preparing the lesson.

explanation: An exercise in writing down what is heard.
h1: 老师用听写检查生词。
e1: The teacher used dictation to check new words.
h2: 听写结束后，我们交换本子检查。
e2: After dictation, we exchanged notebooks to check the answers.

explanation: Supervise students during an examination.
h1: 两位老师轮流监考。
e1: Two teachers took turns supervising the exam.
h2: 监考时不能帮助学生答题。

h2: 他用摄像机记录了学校的演出。
e2: He recorded the school performance with a video camera.

explanation: A camera used to record films or moving images.
h1: 摄影机正在拍摄街头的场景。
e1: The camera is filming a street scene.
h2: 导演让摄影机靠近演员。
e2: The director asked for the camera to move closer to the actor.

explanation: A device that takes photographs.
h1: 这台照相机是爸爸送给我的。
e1: My father gave me this camera.
h2: 请把照相机放回保护袋里。
e2: Put the camera back in its protective bag.

explanation: Make a recorded version of sound or video.
h1: 他们今天录制了新节目。
e1: They recorded a new program today.
h2: 录制结束后，请保存文件。
e2: Save the file after recording ends.

explanation: A device used to record or play sound.
h1: 老师带来一台小录音机。
e1: The teacher brought a small audio recorder.
h2: 旧录音机里还放着一盘磁带。
e2: There is still a tape in the old recorder.

explanation: A device that records or plays video recordings.
h1: 这台录像机已经很多年没用了。
e1: This video recorder has not been used for many years.
h2: 他用录像机保存了家人的演出。
e2: He recorded his family's performance with a video recorder.

explanation: A room specially prepared for recording sound.
h1: 录音室里很安静。
e1: It is very quiet inside the recording studio.
h2: 她第一次走进录音室录歌。
e2: She entered a recording studio to record a song for the first time.

explanation: A tape on which sound is recorded.
h1: 这盒录音带保存着奶奶的声音。
e1: This audio tape preserves Grandmother's voice.
h2: 听完录音带后，请把它放回盒里。
e2: Put the audio tape back in its case after listening.

explanation: An indoor space prepared for photography or filming.
h1: 摄影棚里装了几盏大灯。
e1: Several large lights are set up in the studio.
h2: 今天的广告在摄影棚拍摄。
e2: Today's advertisement is being filmed in a studio.

explanation: Music played behind speech or activity.
h1: 背景音乐太响，听不清对话。
e1: The background music is too loud to hear the dialogue.
h2: 这段视频没有加背景音乐。
e2: No background music was added to this video.

explanation: A sound used to create an atmosphere or event.
h1: 电影里的雨声音效很真实。
e1: The rain sound effect in the film is realistic.
h2: 他给动画加上了脚步音效。
e2: He added footstep sound effects to the animation.

explanation: How clear and faithful reproduced sound is.
h1: 这副耳机的音质不错。
e1: These earphones have good sound quality.
h2: 录音环境会影响音质。
e2: The recording environment affects sound quality.

explanation: The high or low quality of a sound or voice.
h1: 他说话的音调突然升高了。
e1: The pitch of his voice suddenly rose.
h2: 请模仿录音里的音调。
e2: Imitate the pitch in the recording.

explanation: A sound at the upper part of the pitch range.
h1: 这首歌的高音很难唱。
e1: The high notes in this song are difficult to sing.
h2: 笛子发出了清亮的高音。
e2: The flute produced a clear high note.

explanation: A sound at the lower part of the pitch range.
h1: 他的低音很有力量。
e1: His low notes are powerful.
h2: 音箱里的低音调得太重了。
e2: The speaker's bass is set too strongly.

explanation: A separate channel carrying recorded sound.
h1: 这段录音只有一个声道。
e1: This recording has only one audio channel.
h2: 左边声道没有声音，需要检查连接。
e2: The left audio channel is silent; check the connection.

explanation: Sound reproduced through multiple channels with spatial separation.
h1: 这副耳机可以播放立体声。
e1: These earphones can play stereo sound.
h2: 立体声让乐器的位置更清楚。
e2: Stereo sound makes the instruments' positions clearer.

explanation: A vibration that carries sound through a medium.
h1: 声波在空气中传播。
e1: Sound waves travel through the air.
h2: 这个实验比较了不同声波的变化。
e2: This experiment compared changes in different sound waves.

explanation: A pitch pattern that distinguishes spoken syllables.
h1: 这个字的声调是一声。
e1: This character is pronounced with the first tone.
h2: 说错声调可能改变词义。
e2: Using the wrong tone can change a word's meaning.

explanation: An audible sound produced by something.
h1: 走廊里传来轻轻的声响。
e1: A soft sound came from the corridor.
h2: 门关上时没有发出声响。
e2: The door made no sound when it closed.

explanation: A unit of speech pronounced as one rhythmic part.
h1: 这个词有两个音节。
e1: This word has two syllables.
h2: 请把每个音节都读清楚。
e2: Pronounce each syllable clearly.

explanation: A written symbol or sound representing a musical pitch.
h1: 她在纸上画了几个音符。
e1: She drew several musical notes on the paper.
h2: 老师让我们唱出这些音符。
e2: The teacher asked us to sing these notes.

explanation: Prevent sound from passing between spaces.
h1: 这个房间的隔音效果很好。
e1: This room has good soundproofing.
h2: 厚窗帘不能完全隔音。
e2: Thick curtains cannot block sound completely.

explanation: Listen to a transmitted program.
h1: 爷爷每天收听天气预报。
e1: Grandfather listens to the weather forecast every day.
h2: 这段节目可以用手机收听。
e2: This program can be listened to on a phone.

english: pick up sound or radio signals
explanation: Capture sound or receive broadcast signals.
h1: 这个麦克风的收音很清楚。
e1: This microphone picks up sound clearly.
h2: 录制前先测试收音效果。
e2: Test the sound pickup before recording.

explanation: A person who presents spoken broadcasts.
h1: 播音员正在读晚间新闻。
e1: The announcer is reading the evening news.
h2: 她想成为一名播音员。
e2: She wants to become a broadcaster.

explanation: Present information in a spoken broadcast.
h1: 车站正在播报到站信息。
e1: The station is announcing arrival information.
h2: 电台每小时播报一次天气。
e2: The radio station broadcasts the weather every hour.

explanation: Transmit an event while it is happening.
h1: 学校的演出有现场直播。
e1: The school performance is being broadcast live.
h2: 这场比赛正在直播。
e2: This match is being broadcast live.

explanation: Present a play or other performance to an audience.
h1: 剧院下周上演一部新戏。
e1: The theater will stage a new play next week.
h2: 同学们上演了自己编的故事。
e2: The classmates performed a story they wrote themselves.

explanation: Project or play a film for an audience.
h1: 礼堂今晚放映一部纪录片。
e1: The hall is showing a documentary tonight.
h2: 电影放映时请保持安静。
e2: Keep quiet while the film is being shown.

english: be released; be shown in cinemas
explanation: Become available for public cinema viewing.
h1: 这部电影下个月上映。
e1: This film will be released next month.
h2: 她盼着新动画电影上映。
e2: She is looking forward to the new animated film's release.

explanation: A business providing computers and internet access.
h1: 这家网吧有安静的阅读区域。
e1: This internet cafe has a quiet reading area.
h2: 他在网吧打印了一份资料。
e2: He printed a document at the internet cafe.

explanation: A portable flat-screen computing device.
h1: 她用平板阅读电子书。
e1: She reads electronic books on a tablet.
h2: 平板的屏幕比手机大。
e2: The tablet's screen is larger than the phone's.

explanation: A device designed for playing electronic games.
h1: 这台游戏机可以接到电视上。
e1: This game console can connect to the television.
h2: 玩完后，他把游戏机收进柜子。
e2: He put the game console in the cabinet after playing.

explanation: A game played using an electronic device.
h1: 她喜欢需要合作的电子游戏。
e1: She likes video games that require cooperation.
h2: 电子游戏也要安排合理的时间。
e2: Time spent on video games should also be planned reasonably.

explanation: A group of words used together as a meaningful unit.
h1: 这个词组经常出现在新闻里。
e1: This phrase often appears in the news.
h2: 请用这三个词组各造一个句子。
e2: Make a sentence with each of these three phrases.

explanation: A word or topic listed with information in a reference work.
h1: 这个词条给出了两种用法。
e1: This dictionary entry gives two uses.
h2: 编辑给词典增加了一个词条。
e2: The editor added an entry to the dictionary.

explanation: A vocabulary item not yet learned.
h1: 这篇短文里有三个生词。
e1: There are three unfamiliar words in this short passage.
h2: 遇到生词时先读上下文。
e2: Read the context first when encountering an unfamiliar word.

explanation: A reusable grammatical pattern for forming sentences.
h1: 今天我们练习一个新的句型。
e1: Today we are practicing a new sentence pattern.
h2: 这个句型可以用来表示比较。
e2: This sentence pattern can be used to express comparison.

explanation: The structural form in which a sentence is expressed.
h1: 两段文字采用了不同的句式。
e1: The two passages use different sentence structures.
h2: 改变句式可以让表达更自然。
e2: Changing the sentence structure can make the expression more natural.

explanation: A punctuation mark used at the end of a question.
h1: 这个问题后面应该加问号。
e1: A question mark should follow this question.
h2: 她漏写了句末的问号。
e2: She left out the question mark at the end of the sentence.

explanation: A shortened form of a word or expression.
h1: 这个缩写在不同文章里意思不同。
e1: This abbreviation has different meanings in different articles.
h2: 第一次出现缩写时要解释全称。
e2: Explain the full form when an abbreviation first appears.

explanation: Use a shorter written form to save space or time.
h1: 做笔记时可以把常用词简写。
e1: Frequently used words can be shortened when taking notes.
h2: 地址不要随意简写，以免送错。
e2: Do not shorten an address carelessly, or delivery may go wrong.

explanation: Words with similar sounds used for association or wordplay.
h1: 这则广告用了一个有趣的谐音。
e1: This advertisement uses an interesting sound-based pun.
h2: 学习时不要只靠谐音记单词。
e2: Do not rely only on sound associations to memorize words.

explanation: Sharing the same spoken sound.
h1: 这两个字同音，但意思不同。
e1: These two characters sound alike but mean different things.
h2: 同音的词需要靠上下文区分。
e2: Words with the same pronunciation must be distinguished by context.

explanation: An expression deliberately carrying two meanings.
h1: 这句话是一个双关语。
e1: This sentence is a pun.
h2: 理解双关语需要了解上下文。
e2: Understanding a pun requires knowing the context.

explanation: A word describing a quality or condition.
h1: 这个形容词可以描述人的性格。
e1: This adjective can describe a person's character.
h2: 请从文章里找出三个形容词。
e2: Find three adjectives in the article.

explanation: A word naming a person, object, place or concept.
h1: 表示物品名称的词通常是名词。
e1: Words naming objects are usually nouns.
h2: 这道题要求填写一个名词。
e2: This question asks for a noun.

explanation: A grammatical form indicating more than one.
h1: 这个名词的复数形式不规则。
e1: This noun has an irregular plural form.
h2: 句子里指很多人，要使用复数。
e2: The sentence refers to many people, so use the plural.

explanation: Write a word using the correct sequence of letters.
h1: 我不确定这个词的拼写。
e1: I am unsure of this word's spelling.
h2: 请慢一点拼写你的名字。
e2: Spell your name a little more slowly.

explanation: Written or arranged clearly and regularly.
h1: 她的字写得很工整。
e1: Her handwriting is very neat.
h2: 这份笔记工整，容易复习。
e2: These notes are neat and easy to review.

explanation: The text as originally written, before translation or alteration.
h1: 翻译前先仔细阅读原文。
e1: Read the original text carefully before translating.
h2: 引用时不要改变原文。
e2: Do not change the original text when quoting it.

explanation: Explain or understand the meaning of a text or event.
h1: 老师带我们解读这首诗。
e1: The teacher guided us in interpreting this poem.
h2: 不同读者可能有不同的解读。
e2: Different readers may have different interpretations.

explanation: Express existing content in a different form.
h1: 请把这句话改写得更简短。
e1: Rewrite this sentence more briefly.
h2: 她把故事改写成了剧本。
e2: She rewrote the story as a play.

explanation: Read or recite a text aloud with expressive delivery.
h1: 她在台上朗诵一首诗。
e1: She recited a poem on stage.
h2: 朗诵时要注意停顿和节奏。
e2: Pay attention to pauses and rhythm when reciting.

explanation: Read a text aloud repeatedly or expressively.
h1: 学生每天诵读一小段课文。
e1: The students read a short passage aloud each day.
h2: 他通过诵读熟悉文章的节奏。
e2: He became familiar with the passage's rhythm by reading it aloud.

explanation: Learn a subject without regular teacher instruction.
h1: 她利用周末自学摄影。
e1: She studies photography independently on weekends.
h2: 这本书适合中文初学者自学。
e2: This book suits beginners studying Chinese on their own.

explanation: Study independently during an allotted period.
h1: 晚饭后我去图书馆自习。
e1: I go to the library to study after dinner.
h2: 自习时请不要大声交谈。
e2: Do not speak loudly during self-study time.

explanation: Put sustained effort into study or work.
h1: 她很用功，每天都复习。
e1: She studies diligently and reviews every day.
h2: 考试前他比平时更用功。
e2: He studies harder than usual before exams.

explanation: Taking place beyond regular classroom lessons.
h1: 这本书适合课外阅读。
e1: This book is suitable for extracurricular reading.
h2: 他参加了一个课外音乐小组。
e2: He joined an extracurricular music group.

english: attend and listen to a lesson
explanation: Listen to teaching during a class.
h1: 她生病时在家在线听课。
e1: She attended classes online from home while ill.
h2: 认真听课可以减少课后的疑问。
e2: Listening carefully in class can reduce questions afterward.

english: listen to an explanation or lesson
explanation: Pay attention while someone is explaining or teaching.
h1: 老师讲题时，大家专心听讲。
e1: Everyone listened carefully while the teacher explained the problem.
h2: 他边听讲边记笔记。
e2: He took notes while listening to the explanation.

explanation: A book or text intended for reading.
h1: 图书馆增加了儿童读物。
e1: The library added children's reading materials.
h2: 这种读物适合睡前阅读。
e2: This reading material is suitable for bedtime.

explanation: Books considered as physical or learning objects.
h1: 书本不要堆在地上。
e1: Do not pile books on the floor.
h2: 她把书本整齐地放回书包。
e2: She put the books neatly back in her schoolbag.

explanation: The name of a book.

e1: I remember the contents but forgot the book's title.
h2: 请把书名写在借阅单上。
e2: Write the book title on the borrowing slip.

explanation: A single page of a book.
