e1: The pages of this book have yellowed.
h2: 不要折书页，可以用书签。
e2: Use a bookmark instead of folding the pages.

explanation: A small, bound set of printed pages.
h1: 门口可以领取介绍活动的册子。
e1: You can pick up an activity booklet at the entrance.
h2: 这个册子记录了常用的电话。
e2: This booklet lists commonly used phone numbers.

explanation: A short printed booklet with a limited topic.
h1: 老师发了一本发音小册子。
e1: The teacher handed out a pronunciation booklet.
h2: 我把旅游小册子放在背包里。
e2: I put the travel booklet in my backpack.

explanation: A set of books published as a related collection.
h1: 这套丛书介绍不同国家的文化。
e1: This book series introduces different countries' cultures.
h2: 我只买了丛书中的第一本。
e2: I bought only the first book in the series.

explanation: Use another source for guidance or information.
h1: 你可以参考书后的答案。
e1: You can consult the answers at the back of the book.
h2: 设计房间时，她参考了几张照片。
e2: She used several photos as references when designing the room.

explanation: Sources used to support study or research.
h1: 报告最后列出了参考资料。
e1: The report lists its reference materials at the end.
h2: 这些参考资料只能在馆内阅读。
e2: These reference materials may only be read inside the library.

explanation: A small book used for brief written records.
h1: 我随身带着一个记事本。
e1: I carry a small notebook with me.
h2: 把重要日期写进记事本。
e2: Write important dates in the notebook.

explanation: A book used to record daily experiences.
h1: 这本日记本是我的生日礼物。
e1: This diary was my birthday present.
h2: 她把演出的门票夹进日记本。
e2: She put the performance ticket inside her diary.

explanation: A written record of spoken information.
h1: 她把访谈笔录整理成了报告。
e1: She turned the interview transcript into a report.
h2: 请核对笔录是否准确。
e2: Check whether the written record is accurate.

explanation: A small strip or piece of paper carrying a note.
h1: 我在门上发现一张纸条。
e1: I found a paper slip on the door.
h2: 她把号码写在纸条上。
e2: She wrote the number on a slip of paper.

explanation: A short written message on a small piece of paper.
h1: 妈妈留了一张字条，说晚点回来。
e1: Mom left a note saying she would return later.
h2: 桌上的字条提醒我带雨伞。
e2: The note on the table reminds me to bring an umbrella.

explanation: A short written message for practical communication.
h1: 我给同事写了一张便条。
e1: I wrote a short note for my colleague.
h2: 这张便条说明了取资料的时间。
e2: This note states when to collect the materials.

explanation: A short public statement displayed prominently.
h1: 墙上的标语提醒大家节约用水。
e1: The wall slogan reminds people to save water.
h2: 学生为运动会写了几条标语。
e2: The students wrote several slogans for the sports day.

explanation: A book arranged for teaching a school subject.
h1: 这本教科书有很多插图。
e1: This textbook contains many illustrations.
h2: 新版教科书增加了练习题。
e2: The new edition of the textbook has added exercises.

explanation: Content written on a classroom board during teaching.
h1: 老师的板书分成了三部分。
e1: The teacher's board writing is divided into three parts.
h2: 请把重要的板书记在本子上。
e2: Write down the important board notes in your notebook.

explanation: Study tasks or lessons that must be prepared.
h1: 做完功课后，我去散步。
e1: I went for a walk after finishing my schoolwork.
h2: 她每天花一点时间温习功课。
e2: She spends some time reviewing her lessons each day.

explanation: Give guidance in knowledge or proper conduct.
h1: 父母教导孩子要守信用。
e1: Parents teach children to keep their word.
h2: 这位老师耐心教导新来的学生。
e2: This teacher patiently guides the new students.

explanation: The method used to teach a subject or skill.
h1: 老师根据学生的情况调整教法。
e1: The teacher adjusts the teaching method to the students' needs.
h2: 这种教法鼓励学生主动提问。
e2: This teaching method encourages students to ask questions actively.

explanation: Give instruction in a class.
h1: 她上午教课，下午准备材料。
e1: She teaches in the morning and prepares materials in the afternoon.
h2: 爷爷以前在乡村学校教课。
e2: Grandfather used to teach at a village school.

explanation: A person employed to teach or instruct.
h1: 培训中心聘请了两名教员。
e1: The training center hired two instructors.
h2: 这位教员负责指导实际操作。
e2: This instructor is responsible for practical training.

explanation: Work as the teacher or coach of a group.
h1: 她在这所学校执教多年。
e1: She has taught at this school for many years.
h2: 这位教练开始执教青年队。
e2: This coach began coaching the youth team.

explanation: Adjust an error to make something accurate.
h1: 印刷前需要校正错字。
e1: Misprints need correcting before printing.
h2: 这台仪器要定期校正。
e2: This instrument needs regular calibration.

explanation: A staff member who guides students in study or daily life.
h1: 辅导员帮助新生熟悉校园。
e1: The adviser helps new students become familiar with the campus.
h2: 遇到住宿问题，可以找辅导员。
e2: You can contact the adviser about accommodation problems.

explanation: Attend an extra lesson to cover missed material.
h1: 她请假后需要补课。
e1: She needs to make up lessons after taking leave.
h2: 老师安排周五给大家补课。
e2: The teacher arranged a make-up lesson for everyone on Friday.

explanation: Study a subject with additional guidance or lessons.
h1: 他利用假期补习数学。
e1: He took extra mathematics tuition during the holidays.
h2: 补习以后，她理解了以前的难点。
e2: After extra tuition, she understood the points she had found difficult.

explanation: A class providing additional subject teaching.
h1: 她周末去参加英语补习班。
e1: She attends an English tuition class on weekends.
h2: 这个补习班每班只有六个人。
e2: This tuition class has only six people in each group.

explanation: A course designed to teach a practical skill.
h1: 公司安排了一个安全培训班。
e1: The company arranged a safety training course.
h2: 她在摄影培训班认识了新朋友。
e2: She met new friends in a photography training class.

explanation: One part of an academic year.
h1: 这个学期我们换了新教室。
e1: We moved to a new classroom this term.
h2: 学期结束前要归还借来的书。
e2: Return the borrowed books before the term ends.

explanation: The final part of an academic term.
h1: 期末考试安排在六月。
e1: The final examinations are scheduled for June.
h2: 期末时，老师给大家写了评语。
e2: The teacher wrote comments for everyone at the end of the term.

explanation: Begin attendance at an educational institution.
h1: 妹妹今年秋天入学。
e1: My younger sister starts school this autumn.
h2: 入学前需要准备哪些材料？
e2: What documents are needed before entering school?

explanation: Go back to school after an absence.
h1: 假期结束后，学生陆续返校。
e1: The students returned to school after the holidays.
h2: 她康复后已经返校上课。
e2: She has returned to classes after recovering.

explanation: A higher-education institution or a division within one.
h1: 他在音乐学院学习。
e1: He studies at a music college.
h2: 这个学院开设了新的课程。
e2: This faculty has introduced new courses.

explanation: A college or university offering advanced education.
h1: 几所高校联合举办了讲座。
e1: Several higher-education institutions organized the talk together.
h2: 这个展览向附近高校的学生开放。
e2: This exhibition is open to students from nearby colleges and universities.

explanation: A school providing education after primary school.
h1: 这所中学离我家很近。
e1: This secondary school is near my home.
h2: 哥哥在中学参加了篮球队。
e2: My older brother joined a basketball team at secondary school.

explanation: The earlier stage of secondary education.
h1: 她今年开始读初中。
e1: She starts junior secondary school this year.
h2: 这本词典适合初中学生。
e2: This dictionary suits junior secondary students.

explanation: The later stage of secondary education.
h1: 哥哥在高中学习物理。
e1: My older brother studies physics at senior secondary school.
h2: 这所高中有很大的图书馆。
e2: This senior secondary school has a large library.

explanation: A student attending a university.
h1: 几位大学生来学校做志愿服务。
e1: Several university students came to the school to volunteer.
h2: 她是一名学习医学的大学生。
e2: She is a university student studying medicine.

explanation: A child attending primary school.
h1: 小学生过马路时要注意安全。
e1: Primary-school students should be careful when crossing the road.
h2: 这本书为小学生设计。
e2: This book is designed for primary-school students.

explanation: A student attending secondary school.
h1: 这次活动由中学生组织。
e1: This activity was organized by secondary-school students.
h2: 中学生可以借阅这一类读物。
e2: Secondary-school students may borrow this type of reading material.

explanation: A student in the later stage of secondary school.
h1: 几个高中生正在准备演讲。
e1: Several senior secondary students are preparing a speech.
h2: 这份阅读材料适合高中生。
e2: This reading material suits senior secondary students.

explanation: A student newly admitted to an institution.
h1: 老师带新生参观教室。
e1: The teacher showed the new students around the classroom.
h2: 新生入学后要领取课表。
e2: New students collect a timetable after enrollment.

explanation: A person enrolled in a training course.
h1: 这次培训有二十名学员。
e1: There are twenty participants in this training course.
h2: 教员给学员示范了操作方法。
e2: The instructor demonstrated the procedure to the trainees.

explanation: A person taking an examination.
h1: 考生应提前找到自己的座位。
e1: Candidates should find their seats beforehand.
h2: 每位考生都领到了一份试卷。
e2: Each candidate received an exam paper.

explanation: A person who evaluates an examination candidate.
h1: 考官请她读一段文章。
e1: The examiner asked her to read a passage.
h2: 两位考官分别记录了成绩。
e2: The two examiners recorded the results separately.

explanation: A document listing a student's results.
h1: 她把成绩单带回家给父母看。
e1: She brought her grade report home to show her parents.
h2: 申请学校时需要提交成绩单。
e2: An academic transcript is required when applying to a school.

explanation: Give a numerical evaluation according to criteria.
h1: 老师按照统一标准评分。
e1: The teacher marked the work using one standard.
h2: 评分结束后会公布结果。
e2: The results will be announced after scoring ends.

explanation: A distinct subject studied or examined.
h1: 这个学期增加了新的科目。
e1: A new subject was added this term.
h2: 请注明你要报考的科目。
e2: State the subject you want to be examined in.

explanation: The study of places, environments and their relationships.
h1: 地理课上我们学习看地图。
e1: We learn to read maps in geography class.
h2: 她对家乡的地理很熟悉。
e2: She is familiar with the geography of her hometown.

explanation: Comprehend the meaning of written material.
h1: 我终于读懂了这封信。
e1: I finally understood this letter.
h2: 这段说明太复杂，不容易读懂。
e2: These instructions are complicated and difficult to understand.

explanation: Comprehend spoken language or explanation.
h1: 他说得很慢，我都听懂了。
e1: He spoke slowly, and I understood everything.
h2: 如果没听懂，可以请老师再说一次。
e2: If you do not understand, ask the teacher to repeat it.

explanation: A person employed by an organization, especially in office work.
h1: 这家公司有三十名职员。
e1: This company has thirty employees.
h2: 前台职员帮我联系了负责人。
e2: The front-desk staff member helped me contact the person in charge.

explanation: Workers and employees of an organization collectively.
h1: 工厂为职工安排了体检。
e1: The factory arranged health checks for its employees.
h2: 职工可以在食堂吃午饭。
e2: Employees can have lunch in the canteen.

explanation: A learner gaining practical experience in a workplace.
h1: 实习生正在学习整理档案。
e1: The intern is learning to organize records.
h2: 部门给每位实习生安排了指导老师。
e2: The department assigned a mentor to each intern.

explanation: A worker employed for a limited period.
h1: 店里请了两名临时工帮忙。
e1: The shop hired two temporary workers to help.
h2: 她暑假做过临时工。
e2: She worked as a temporary worker during the summer holidays.

explanation: The person managing an organization's overall operations.
h1: 总经理在会议上介绍了新计划。
e1: The general manager introduced the new plan at the meeting.
h2: 她今天需要向总经理汇报进度。
e2: She needs to report progress to the general manager today.

explanation: A manager who supports or substitutes for the main manager.
h1: 经理不在时由副经理负责。
e1: The deputy manager is in charge when the manager is absent.
h2: 副经理协调了各组的工作。
e2: The deputy manager coordinated the groups' work.

explanation: A person who helps another person with work duties.
h1: 助理把会议资料送到了办公室。
e1: The assistant delivered the meeting materials to the office.
h2: 她担任摄影师的助理。
e2: She works as a photographer's assistant.

explanation: A person who provides specialist advice.
h1: 公司请顾问检查了培训方案。
e1: The company asked a consultant to review the training plan.
h2: 这位顾问熟悉学校管理。
e2: This adviser is familiar with school management.

explanation: A professional who prepares and reviews financial records.
h1: 会计师正在核对账目。
e1: The accountant is checking the accounts.
h2: 她找会计师咨询公司的财务问题。
e2: She consulted an accountant about the company's finances.

explanation: The person who creates the plan or form of something.
h1: 这张椅子的设计者考虑了儿童身高。
e1: The designer of this chair considered children's height.
h2: 展览介绍了每件作品的设计者。
e2: The exhibition introduces the designer of each work.

explanation: A person who works alongside another worker.
h1: 工友帮他搬走了重箱子。
e1: His fellow worker helped move the heavy box.
h2: 休息时，工友们一起聊天。
e2: The workers chat together during breaks.

explanation: A matter arising from one's job or public duties.
h1: 这次出差是为了处理公事。
e1: This business trip is for work-related matters.
h2: 她习惯把公事和私事分开。
e2: She prefers to keep work matters separate from personal matters.

explanation: A space used for creative or professional work.
h1: 她的工作室里放满了画。
e1: Her studio is full of paintings.
h2: 工作室每周开放一次。
e2: The studio opens to visitors once a week.

explanation: A computer or equipped station used for professional tasks.
h1: 这台工作站用来处理大型图像。
e1: This workstation processes large images.
h2: 每个工作站旁都放着操作说明。
e2: Operating instructions are beside each workstation.

explanation: A group formed to carry out a particular task.
h1: 学校成立了一个活动工作组。
e1: The school formed a working group for the event.
h2: 工作组每周检查一次进度。
e2: The working group checks progress each week.

explanation: The amount of work that needs to be done.
h1: 这周的工作量比上周大。
e1: The workload is heavier this week than last week.
h2: 新工具减少了重复的工作量。
e2: The new tool reduced repetitive work.

explanation: The ordered steps followed when performing a job.
h1: 新员工先学习工作流程。
e1: New employees learn the workflow first.
h2: 我们简化了文件审批的工作流程。
e2: We simplified the workflow for document approval.

explanation: A desk used for office work.
h1: 我的办公桌靠近窗户。
e1: My office desk is near the window.
h2: 下班前请整理办公桌。
e2: Tidy your office desk before leaving work.

explanation: A building containing workplaces and offices.
h1: 这栋办公楼有六层。
e1: This office building has six floors.
h2: 她在办公楼门口等同事。
e2: She is waiting for her colleague outside the office building.

explanation: The department handling employee-related affairs.
h1: 请把请假申请交给人事部。
e1: Submit the leave request to the personnel department.
h2: 人事部通知我下周面试。
e2: The personnel department informed me of an interview next week.

explanation: The workforce and its management within an organization.
h1: 她在人力资源部门工作。
e1: She works in the human resources department.
h2: 合理安排人力资源能减少加班。
e2: Planning human resources properly can reduce overtime.

explanation: A person looking or applying for employment.
h1: 求职者在门口等候面试。
e1: The job applicants waited outside for interviews.
h2: 这次活动向求职者介绍了招聘信息。
e2: This event introduced recruitment information to job seekers.

explanation: Begin serving in a job or official role.
h1: 她明天到新公司就职。
e1: She starts her position at the new company tomorrow.
h2: 他就职后先熟悉了团队。
e2: He got to know the team after taking up the position.

explanation: Find or hold paid work.
h1: 培训帮助学员提高就业能力。
e1: The training helps participants improve their employability.
h2: 毕业后，她选择在家乡就业。
e2: After graduation, she chose to work in her hometown.

explanation: Accept a person for a job or position.
h1: 通过面试后，她被公司录用了。
e1: The company hired her after the interview.
h2: 录用通知将在下周发出。
e2: The appointment notice will be sent next week.

explanation: A skill or field in which someone is particularly capable.
h1: 他的专长是修理旧家具。
e1: His specialty is repairing old furniture.
h2: 老师鼓励每个人发挥自己的专长。
e2: The teacher encourages everyone to use their particular skills.

explanation: Carry out assigned responsibilities properly.
h1: 这位管理员很尽职。
e1: This administrator performs her duties conscientiously.
h2: 他尽职地检查了每一个出口。
e2: He checked every exit conscientiously.

explanation: Taking one's work seriously and responsibly.
h1: 她虽然经验少，但十分敬业。
e1: She lacks experience but is very dedicated to her work.
h2: 敬业不等于永远不休息。
e2: Dedication to work does not mean never resting.

explanation: Fail to perform responsibilities properly.
h1: 漏掉重要检查被认为是失职。
e1: Missing an important check was considered neglect of duty.
h2: 发现失职问题后，团队改进了流程。
e2: The team improved the process after finding a failure of duty.

explanation: Begin a construction or production task.
h1: 材料到齐以后就可以开工。
e1: Work can begin once all the materials arrive.
h2: 工人们早上七点开工。
e2: The workers start work at seven in the morning.

english: finish a construction or production task
explanation: Complete the work on a project or product.
h1: 这座小桥下周就能完工。
e1: This small bridge can be finished next week.
h2: 房间完工后还要检查一次。
e2: The room needs another inspection after the work is finished.

explanation: The planned time allowed for completing work.
h1: 下雨使工期延长了几天。
e1: Rain extended the construction period by several days.
h2: 这项维修的工期是一周。
e2: The repair is scheduled to take one week.

explanation: Start building or carrying out construction work.
h1: 新教室下个月动工。
e1: Construction of the new classroom begins next month.
h2: 动工前，工作人员检查了地面。
e2: Staff inspected the ground before construction began.

explanation: A place where building work is taking place.
h1: 工地旁边设了安全围栏。
e1: A safety fence was set up beside the construction site.
h2: 经过工地时要注意路面。
e2: Watch the ground when passing the construction site.

explanation: Be responsible for work during an assigned period.
h1: 今晚由我值班。
e1: I am on duty tonight.
h2: 值班人员会记录来访信息。
e2: The staff on duty record visitor information.

explanation: Work the currently assigned shift.
h1: 请找当班的负责人。
e1: Please find the supervisor on the current shift.
h2: 她当班时遇到了一次停电。
e2: She experienced a power outage while on shift.

explanation: Replace one shift of workers with another.
h1: 两组工作人员在中午换班。
e1: The two staff groups change shifts at noon.
h2: 换班前要交代未完成的工作。
e2: Explain unfinished tasks before changing shifts.

explanation: A work period scheduled late in the day.
h1: 她这周上晚班。
e1: She works the evening shift this week.
h2: 晚班结束后，食堂已经关门了。
e2: The canteen had closed by the time the evening shift ended.

explanation: A work period starting early in the day.
h1: 我明天上早班，要早点睡。
e1: I have the morning shift tomorrow and need to sleep early.
h2: 早班的同事已经准备好材料。
e2: The morning-shift colleagues have prepared the materials.

explanation: An assigned shift or scheduled round of operation.
h1: 下周的班次安排已经贴出来。
e1: Next week's shift schedule has been posted.
h2: 她想和同事交换一个班次。
e2: She wants to exchange a shift with a colleague.

explanation: Be present when scheduled to work or study.
h1: 老师记录了本周的出勤情况。
e1: The teacher recorded attendance for this week.
h2: 暴雨影响了员工出勤。
e2: Heavy rain affected employee attendance.

explanation: End a job or remove someone from a position.
h1: 她辞掉工作去继续学习。
e1: She quit her job to continue studying.
h2: 他没有因为一时生气就辞掉工作。
e2: He did not quit his job just because he was momentarily angry.

explanation: Move from one employer to another.
h1: 他跳槽到一家规模更小的公司。
e1: He moved to a smaller company.
h2: 跳槽之前，她仔细比较了工作内容。
e2: She carefully compared job duties before changing employers.

explanation: Give tasks or resources to different people.
h1: 经理把任务分派给各组。
e1: The manager assigned the tasks to the different groups.
h2: 工作应按照能力合理分派。
e2: Work should be allocated according to people's abilities.

explanation: Separate people or items into several groups.
h1: 老师按兴趣给学生分组。
e1: The teacher grouped students by their interests.
h2: 活动开始前，大家先分组。
e2: Everyone divided into groups before the activity began.

explanation: Give one or more items to each recipient.
h1: 同学们帮忙分发资料。
e1: The classmates helped hand out the materials.
h2: 请把这些练习本分发给大家。
e2: Hand these exercise books out to everyone.

explanation: Work together in a coordinated way.
h1: 两个部门协同处理了这件事。
e1: The two departments handled the matter together.
h2: 设备需要协同运行才能完成任务。
e2: The devices must operate together to finish the task.

explanation: Discuss a matter to reach an agreed arrangement.
h1: 时间冲突时，可以先协商。
e1: When schedules conflict, discuss an arrangement first.
h2: 双方协商后决定延期。
e2: The two sides agreed to postpone after discussions.

explanation: Consider a matter together to make a decision.
h1: 老师们正在商讨活动安排。
e1: The teachers are discussing the activity arrangements.
h2: 这个问题需要和家人商讨。
e2: This issue needs discussing with the family.

explanation: Discuss something face to face.
h1: 复杂的问题最好约时间面谈。
e1: It is better to arrange an in-person discussion for complicated issues.
h2: 她和老师面谈了学习计划。
e2: She discussed her study plan with the teacher in person.

explanation: Have an arranged discussion about significant matters.
h1: 学校和家长代表举行了会谈。
e1: The school held talks with parent representatives.
h2: 这次会谈讨论了学生住宿。
e2: These talks discussed student accommodation.

explanation: Talk about a practical matter to reach an arrangement.
h1: 他们正在商谈合作方式。
e1: They are discussing how to cooperate.
h2: 房租到期前，她和房东商谈续租。
e2: She discussed renewing the rental with the landlord before it expired.

explanation: A meeting devoted to discussing a specialized subject.
h1: 她参加了一场教学研讨会。
e1: She attended a seminar on teaching.
h2: 研讨会最后安排了小组交流。
e2: Group discussions were arranged at the end of the seminar.

explanation: A meeting arranged for exchanging views on a topic.
h1: 班级下周开一次读书讨论会。
e1: The class will hold a reading discussion next week.
h2: 讨论会欢迎大家提出不同意见。
e2: The discussion meeting welcomes different opinions.

explanation: Receive or meet a person in an arranged setting.
h1: 校长会见了来访的教师。
e1: The principal met the visiting teachers.
h2: 会见结束后，大家参观了校园。
e2: Everyone toured the campus after the meeting.

explanation: Come together at an agreed place.
h1: 我们在图书馆门口会合。
e1: We met up at the library entrance.
h2: 两组队员下午在山脚会合。
e2: The two groups met at the foot of the mountain in the afternoon.

explanation: Have a brief informal meeting.
h1: 我们午饭前碰头商量一下。
e1: Let's meet briefly before lunch to discuss it.
h2: 他们每周碰头一次，交换进度。
e2: They meet briefly once a week to share progress.

english: arrange to meet or do something together
explanation: Make a shared plan with another person.
h1: 我们相约周末去看展览。
e1: We arranged to visit the exhibition together on the weekend.
h2: 几位旧友相约回母校看看。
e2: Several old friends arranged to visit their former school together.

explanation: Organize ideas and preparations for a future activity.
h1: 她正在筹划一次小型展览。
e1: She is planning a small exhibition.
h2: 这次旅行筹划了很久。
e2: This trip was planned for a long time.

explanation: Create an organized plan, standard or policy.
h1: 老师和学生一起制订学习计划。
e1: The teacher and students formulated a study plan together.
h2: 团队正在制订新的工作标准。
e2: The team is drawing up new work standards.

explanation: A matter placed on an agenda for discussion.
h1: 今天会议的议题是课程安排。
e1: Today's meeting topic is the course schedule.
h2: 这个议题需要更多资料。
e2: This discussion topic needs more information.

explanation: A focused treatment of one particular subject.
h1: 杂志做了一个阅读专题。
e1: The magazine prepared a special feature on reading.
h2: 这次讲座是关于城市交通的专题。
e2: This lecture focuses specifically on urban transport.

explanation: One of a limited number of available positions.
h1: 这个课程只剩两个名额。
e1: Only two places remain on this course.
h2: 报名成功不代表一定有名额。
e2: Successful registration does not guarantee an available place.

explanation: A written record of matters to remember or communicate.
h1: 她把约定写进备忘录。
e1: She recorded the agreement in a reminder note.
h2: 这份备忘录列出了后续任务。
e2: This memorandum lists the follow-up tasks.

explanation: A short report summarizing important developments.
h1: 经理在早会上读了一份简报。
e1: The manager read a brief report at the morning meeting.
h2: 学校每月发布活动简报。
e2: The school publishes an activity bulletin every month.

english: report to a person or group
explanation: Give an organized account of progress or results.
h1: 她向老师汇报了调查结果。
e1: She reported the survey results to the teacher.
h2: 每组用五分钟汇报进度。
e2: Each group has five minutes to report its progress.

explanation: Send information to a higher authority or department.
h1: 发现问题后要及时上报。
e1: Report a problem to the higher level promptly when it is found.
h2: 工作人员把数据上报给主管。
e2: The staff reported the data to the supervisor.

explanation: A structured table presenting recorded results or figures.
h1: 这张报表显示了本月支出。
e1: This statement shows this month's expenditure.
h2: 提交报表前请核对数字。
e2: Check the figures before submitting the report form.

explanation: A document recording terms agreed by parties.
h1: 双方在协议书上签字。
e1: Both sides signed the written agreement.
h2: 这份协议书明确了合作期限。
e2: This agreement states the period of cooperation.

explanation: Formally agree to a contract by signing it.
h1: 学校与机构签订了合作协议。
e1: The school signed a cooperation agreement with the organization.
h2: 签订合同前要仔细阅读条款。
e2: Read the terms carefully before signing the contract.

explanation: Help someone or something with money.
h1: 这个项目资助学生完成研究。
e1: This project provides students with funding for their research.
h2: 她希望资助家乡的图书室。
e2: She hopes to fund her hometown's reading room.

explanation: Provide resources to support an event or project.
h1: 本地企业赞助了学校的比赛。
e1: A local company sponsored the school competition.
h2: 活动主办方正在寻找赞助。
e2: The event organizer is looking for sponsorship.

explanation: Support or benefits provided to employees or a community.
h1: 公司介绍了员工福利。
e1: The company explained its employee benefits.
h2: 这项福利包括定期健康检查。
e2: This benefit includes regular health checks.

explanation: Handle a matter on behalf of another person or organization.
h1: 她代理同事处理了当天的工作。
e1: She handled the day's work on behalf of her colleague.
h2: 这个代理负责联系不同的出版社。
e2: This agent contacts different publishers.

explanation: One connected part of a larger process.
h1: 最后一个环节是提问。
e1: The final part is for questions.
h2: 这个环节出了问题，会影响后面。
e2: A problem at this step will affect what follows.

explanation: The development of an activity through time.
h1: 天气影响了比赛进程。
e1: The weather affected the course of the match.
h2: 老师定期检查学习进程。
e2: The teacher regularly checks the progress of learning.

explanation: The time needed for a recurring process.
h1: 这项检查的周期是一个月。
e1: This check repeats on a monthly cycle.
h2: 不同植物的生长周期不一样。
e2: Different plants have different growth cycles.

explanation: Accumulated understanding of a subject or the skill behind an activity.
h1: 养花也有不少学问。
e1: There is plenty to learn about growing flowers too.
h2: 他愿意向有学问的人请教。
e2: He likes asking knowledgeable people for advice.

explanation: A belief or idea that guides choices and actions.
h1: 这所学校重视合作的教育理念。
e1: This school values an educational philosophy of cooperation.
h2: 设计理念是让阅读更舒服。
e2: The guiding design idea is to make reading more comfortable.

explanation: Useful in real situations.
h1: 这本小册子很实用。
e1: This booklet is very practical.
h2: 她送给我一份实用的旅行清单。
e2: She gave me a useful travel checklist.

explanation: A useful or successful result of effort.
h1: 坚持练习后，学习有了成效。
e1: Regular practice produced results in learning.
h2: 新办法的成效还需要观察。
e2: The effectiveness of the new method still needs observing.

explanation: Reduce effort or unnecessary trouble.
h1: 提前准备材料比较省事。
e1: Preparing the materials ahead of time saves trouble.
h2: 这个工具让整理照片更省事。
e2: This tool makes organizing photos less troublesome.

explanation: Require or use less physical effort.
h1: 用小车搬箱子更省力。
e1: Moving boxes with a trolley takes less effort.
h2: 这个把手的设计很省力。
e2: The design of this handle makes it easy to use.

explanation: Remove a step or item that is unnecessary.
h1: 网上提交可以省去邮寄步骤。
e1: Submitting online removes the need to post the documents.
h2: 这句话可以省去最后一个词。
e2: The last word can be omitted from this sentence.

explanation: Use less time, money or other resources.
h1: 提前订票可以节省一些钱。
e1: Booking early can save some money.
h2: 大家共用资料能节省纸张。
e2: Sharing materials can save paper.

explanation: Move an action to an earlier time.
h1: 她提早十分钟到了教室。
e1: She arrived in the classroom ten minutes early.
h2: 如果天气变差，我们会提早回家。
e2: We will go home earlier if the weather gets worse.

explanation: At the earliest practical time.
h1: 有问题请尽早告诉我。
e1: Tell me as early as possible if there is a problem.
h2: 她希望尽早完成作业。
e2: She hopes to finish the homework as early as possible.

explanation: Remind or press someone to carry out a task.
h1: 老师督促我们按时交作业。
e1: The teacher urged us to hand in homework on time.
h2: 她设置提醒，督促自己每天练习。
e2: She set reminders to encourage herself to practice daily.

explanation: Give someone reasons or confidence to act.
h1: 这次进步激励她继续学习。
e1: This improvement motivated her to keep studying.
h2: 老师用具体的肯定激励学生。
e2: The teacher motivates students with specific praise.

explanation: Increase someone's confidence or enthusiasm.
h1: 同学们的支持让他很受鼓舞。
e1: His classmates' support greatly encouraged him.
h2: 这次成功鼓舞了整个团队。
e2: This success lifted the whole team's spirits.

explanation: Manage one's life or responsibilities independently.
h1: 她离家以后学会了自立。
e1: She learned to be self-reliant after leaving home.
h2: 父母鼓励孩子逐渐自立。
e2: The parents encourage their child to become independent gradually.

explanation: Provide help to each other.
h1: 同学们组成了互助小组。
e1: The classmates formed a mutual-help group.
h2: 邻里互助让生活方便很多。
e2: Neighbors helping one another makes life much easier.

explanation: Work in the same setting or on shared tasks.
h1: 我们曾经共事三年。
e1: We worked together for three years.
h2: 与她共事让我学到很多。
e2: Working with her taught me a lot.

explanation: Attend social activities connected with work or obligations.
h1: 他今晚有工作上的应酬。
e1: He has a work-related social engagement tonight.
h2: 她尽量减少不必要的应酬。
e2: She tries to reduce unnecessary social obligations.

explanation: Follow an agreement or attend as promised.
h1: 约好时间以后，双方都要守约。
e1: Both sides should keep the agreement after setting a time.
h2: 她一向守约，从不无故迟到。
e2: She always keeps her appointments and is never late without reason.

explanation: Do what one has promised to do.
h1: 答应别人的事情要守信用。
e1: Keep your word about things you promise others.
h2: 他很守信用，按时还了书。
e2: He kept his word and returned the book on time.

explanation: Continue to follow a promise or commitment.
h1: 双方都应信守承诺。
e1: Both sides should honor their promises.
h2: 她信守约定，没有透露朋友的秘密。
e2: She kept the agreement and did not reveal her friend's secret.

explanation: An awareness of being accountable for one's duties.
h1: 照顾植物培养了他的责任感。
e1: Caring for plants developed his sense of responsibility.
h2: 她对这项工作有很强的责任感。
e2: She has a strong sense of responsibility toward this work.

explanation: A willingness to take duties seriously.
h1: 这位老师很有责任心。
e1: This teacher takes her responsibilities seriously.
h2: 养宠物需要耐心和责任心。
e2: Keeping a pet requires patience and a responsible attitude.

english: right to speak; influence in discussion
explanation: The right or standing to express views on a matter.
h1: 每个组员都应该有发言权。
e1: Every group member should have the right to speak.
h2: 了解实际情况才能更有发言权。
e2: Knowing the situation gives you a stronger voice in the discussion.

explanation: An idea or feeling left by an experience.
h1: 这座城市给我留下了很好的印象。
e1: This city left a very good impression on me.
h2: 我对那次比赛还有一点印象。
e2: I still have some memory of that match.

explanation: Have mutual feelings of love.
h1: 他们相爱多年，仍然关心彼此。
e1: They have loved each other for years and still care about each other.
h2: 相爱的人也需要学会沟通。
e2: People who love each other still need to learn to communicate.

english: fall in love with; become fond of
explanation: Begin to feel love or strong liking for someone or something.
h1: 他在一次旅行中爱上了摄影。
e1: He became fond of photography during a trip.
h2: 她慢慢爱上了这座安静的小城。
e2: She gradually fell in love with this quiet small town.

explanation: A male partner in a romantic relationship.
h1: 她和男友一起准备晚饭。
e1: She and her boyfriend prepared dinner together.
h2: 她把男友介绍给了家人。
e2: She introduced her boyfriend to her family.

explanation: A female partner in a romantic relationship.
h1: 他的女友喜欢读旅行故事。
e1: His girlfriend enjoys reading travel stories.
h2: 他陪女友去参加朋友的婚礼。
e2: He accompanied his girlfriend to a friend's wedding.

explanation: Two people who are in a romantic relationship.
h1: 这对情侣每周一起去散步。
e1: This couple goes for a walk together every week.
h2: 这对情侣一起经营一家小店。
e2: The couple runs a small shop together.

explanation: A relationship involving romantic love.
h1: 她不愿公开自己的恋情。
e1: She does not want to make her romantic relationship public.
h2: 这段恋情让他学会更好地沟通。
e2: This relationship taught him to communicate better.

explanation: The affection and trust between friends.
h1: 我们珍惜多年的友情。
e1: We value our years of friendship.
h2: 即使住得很远，友情也没有变。
e2: Our friendship has not changed even though we live far apart.

explanation: Build friendships with other people.
h1: 阅读小组给她提供了交友的机会。
e1: The reading group gave her opportunities to make friends.
h2: 交友时要尊重彼此的选择。
e2: Respect each other's choices when making friends.

explanation: Get to know people and build friendships.
h1: 他喜欢在活动中交朋友。
e1: He likes making friends at activities.
h2: 刚到新学校时，她不太会交朋友。
e2: She was unsure how to make friends when she first arrived at the new school.

explanation: The closeness built through personal contact.
h1: 我和这位邻居有多年交情。
e1: This neighbor and I have known each other well for years.
h2: 他们工作上认识，但没有深的交情。
e2: They know each other through work but are not close friends.

explanation: Care, obligations or favors arising from human relationships.
h1: 她记得别人帮忙的人情。
e1: She remembers the favors others have done for her.
h2: 处理事情时也要考虑人情。
e2: Human relationships should also be considered when handling matters.

explanation: People one knows who can provide connections or support.
h1: 她在志愿活动中积累了人脉。
e1: She built a network of contacts through volunteering.
h2: 人脉不能代替真正的能力。
e2: Connections cannot replace real ability.

explanation: Relationships between people in a social setting.
h1: 良好的人际关系需要沟通。
e1: Good interpersonal relationships require communication.
h2: 他希望改善办公室的人际关系。
e2: He hopes to improve relationships in the office.

explanation: An interconnected set of social contacts.
h1: 共同的兴趣扩大了她的关系网。
e1: Shared interests expanded her network of relationships.
h2: 他通过关系网找到了一位合适的老师。
e2: He found a suitable teacher through his network of contacts.

explanation: A person one knows but may not be close to.
h1: 我在车站遇见一位熟人。
e1: I met an acquaintance at the station.
h2: 因为是熟人，她很快放松下来。
e2: She relaxed quickly because the person was someone she knew.

explanation: A friend with whom one shares a close relationship.
h1: 她把烦恼告诉了密友。
e1: She told her close friend about her worries.
h2: 两位密友经常一起读书。
e2: The two close friends often read together.

explanation: A friend known from an earlier time.
h1: 他在旅行时遇到了旧友。
e1: He met an old friend while traveling.
h2: 旧友来访，让她想起了学生时代。
e2: The old friend's visit reminded her of her student days.

explanation: A friend who understands one's thoughts and feelings deeply.
h1: 她把这位同学当作知己。
e1: She considers this classmate a close confidant.
h2: 能遇到理解自己的知己很难得。
e2: Finding a friend who truly understands you is precious.

explanation: A person who shares a room or accommodation.
h1: 我的室友习惯早睡。
e1: My roommate prefers going to bed early.
h2: 她和室友商量了打扫的安排。
e2: She discussed the cleaning schedule with her roommate.

explanation: A member of the same team.
h1: 队友在场边鼓励他。
e1: His teammates encouraged him from the sidelines.
h2: 训练结束后，她和队友一起回家。
e2: She went home with her teammates after training.

explanation: Treating others with warmth and goodwill.
h1: 新同学对大家很友善。
e1: The new classmate is friendly toward everyone.
h2: 他的友善让陌生人也愿意聊天。
e2: His friendliness makes even strangers willing to chat.

explanation: A wish to help or care for others.
h1: 她是好心提醒我带伞。
e1: She kindly reminded me to bring an umbrella.
h2: 这位好心的邻居帮我搬了箱子。
e2: This kindhearted neighbor helped me move the box.

explanation: A positive intention behind a helpful action.
h1: 我明白你的好意，但想自己试试。
e1: I understand your kind intentions, but want to try it myself.
h2: 他把我的好意误解了。
e2: He misunderstood my good intentions.

explanation: Words that praise, comfort or present something favorably.
h1: 他只想听好话，不愿听建议。
e1: He only wants favorable comments and not advice.
h2: 一句好话能让人心情轻松一些。
e2: A kind word can help someone feel a little more relaxed.

explanation: A positive feeling toward a person or thing.
h1: 她对这位新老师很有好感。
e1: She has a favorable impression of the new teacher.
h2: 整洁的环境增加了客人的好感。
e2: The tidy surroundings improved the visitors' impression.

explanation: An intention that is kind rather than harmful.
h1: 我把这句话理解为善意的提醒。
e1: I understood this as a well-intentioned reminder.
h2: 争论时也要保留善意。
e2: Keep a sense of goodwill even when disagreeing.

explanation: Expressing real feelings without pretending.
h1: 我真心希望你学得开心。
e1: I sincerely hope you enjoy learning.
h2: 她用真心换来了朋友的信任。
e2: Her sincerity won her friend's trust.

explanation: A genuine willingness to act respectfully or cooperatively.
h1: 这封道歉信表达了他的诚意。
e1: This apology letter expressed his sincerity.
h2: 双方都拿出了合作的诚意。
e2: Both sides showed genuine willingness to cooperate.

explanation: Coming genuinely from one's deepest feelings.
h1: 我们向老师表示衷心的感谢。
e1: We offer heartfelt thanks to the teacher.
h2: 她收到朋友衷心的祝福。
e2: She received sincere wishes from her friend.

explanation: The feeling of appreciation for kindness or help.
h1: 她用一张卡片表达谢意。
e1: She expressed her gratitude with a card.
h2: 我不知道怎样表示自己的谢意。
e2: I do not know how to express my gratitude.

explanation: Recognize and appreciate help or kindness received.
h1: 她感恩家人一直支持自己。
e1: She is grateful for her family's continued support.
h2: 感恩不一定需要昂贵的礼物。
e2: Showing gratitude does not require an expensive gift.

explanation: Formally show gratitude.
h1: 演出结束后，学生向老师致谢。
e1: The students thanked the teacher after the performance.
h2: 他在文章结尾向帮助者致谢。
e2: He thanked those who helped him at the end of the article.

explanation: Formally express regret for a mistake or inconvenience.
h1: 负责人为延误向大家致歉。
e1: The person in charge apologized to everyone for the delay.
h2: 她写信向朋友致歉。
e2: She wrote to apologize to her friend.

explanation: The regret felt over causing inconvenience or harm.
h1: 他为迟到表达了歉意。
e1: He expressed regret for being late.
h2: 她带着歉意解释了情况。
e2: She explained the situation apologetically.

explanation: Feeling regret for having failed or hurt someone.
h1: 让朋友久等，他感到愧疚。
e1: He felt guilty for keeping his friend waiting.
h2: 她因为忘记约定而有些愧疚。
e2: She felt some remorse for forgetting the appointment.

explanation: Respect for one's own worth and dignity.
h1: 当众取笑别人会伤害他的自尊。
e1: Making fun of someone publicly can hurt their self-respect.
h2: 她学会了表达需要，也保留了自尊。
e2: She learned to express her needs while keeping her self-respect.

explanation: Sensitivity to one's worth and how others treat it.
h1: 批评时要顾及对方的自尊心。
e1: Consider the other person's dignity when criticizing.
h2: 他自尊心很强，不愿接受嘲笑。
e2: He has a strong sense of dignity and does not accept ridicule.

explanation: Belief in one's ability to handle a task.
h1: 这次成功增强了她的自信心。
e1: This success strengthened her self-confidence.
h2: 老师帮助他慢慢建立自信心。
e2: The teacher helped him gradually build self-confidence.

explanation: The feeling of being safe and supported.
h1: 熟悉的声音给孩子安全感。
e1: A familiar voice gives the child a sense of security.
h2: 稳定的约定能增加彼此的安全感。
e2: Reliable agreements can increase both people's sense of security.

explanation: Satisfaction from completing something meaningful.
h1: 做完第一幅画，她很有成就感。
e1: She felt a sense of achievement after finishing her first painting.
h2: 小目标也能带来成就感。
e2: Small goals can also bring a sense of achievement.

explanation: Expecting positive possibilities despite difficulties.
h1: 虽然进度慢，她仍然很乐观。
e1: She remains optimistic despite slow progress.
h2: 他对新学期保持乐观的态度。
e2: He keeps an optimistic attitude toward the new term.

explanation: The pleasure found in an activity or experience.
h1: 他在做饭中发现了乐趣。
e1: He found enjoyment in cooking.
h2: 和朋友一起学习增加了乐趣。
e2: Studying with friends made it more enjoyable.

explanation: A person who enjoys and takes interest in an activity.
h1: 这次活动吸引了很多摄影爱好者。
e1: This event attracted many photography enthusiasts.
h2: 她是一位古典音乐爱好者。
e2: She is a classical music enthusiast.

explanation: A person particularly interested in films.
h1: 这位影迷收藏了很多电影海报。
e1: This film fan has collected many film posters.
h2: 影迷们在活动后交流观后感。
e2: The film fans discussed their impressions after the event.

explanation: Something a person sincerely wants to happen.
h1: 她的心愿是学会画画。
e1: Her wish is to learn to paint.
h2: 爷爷终于实现了多年的心愿。
e2: Grandfather finally fulfilled a wish he had held for years.

explanation: Feelings or thoughts one deeply wants to express.
h1: 这首歌说出了她的心声。
e1: This song expressed her inner feelings.
h2: 老师鼓励学生说出心声。
e2: The teacher encouraged students to voice their true feelings.

explanation: What a person is thinking about or concentrating on.
h1: 她的心思都放在学习上。
e1: Her attention is focused entirely on studying.
h2: 我看不出他真正的心思。
e2: I cannot tell what he is really thinking.

explanation: The deepest part of one's private feelings.
h1: 他从心底感谢朋友的帮助。
e1: He thanks his friend from the bottom of his heart.
h2: 这段回忆一直留在她心底。
e2: This memory has stayed deep in her heart.

explanation: Hold a feeling or intention within oneself.
h1: 她心怀感激地接受了帮助。
e1: She accepted the help with gratitude.
h2: 即使遇到困难，他仍心怀希望。
e2: He still cherishes hope despite difficulties.

explanation: How open or tolerant a person's attitude is.
h1: 他心胸开阔，愿意听不同意见。
e1: He is open-minded and willing to hear different views.
h2: 不要因为小事让心胸变得狭窄。
e2: Do not let small matters make you narrow-minded.

explanation: A person's moral nature or intentions.
h1: 这位邻居心地善良。
e1: This neighbor has a kind nature.
h2: 她的心地从平时的小事就能看出来。
e2: Her character shows in small everyday actions.

explanation: Words expressing one's genuine feelings.
h1: 他终于向朋友说了心里话。
e1: He finally told his friend his true feelings.
h2: 这封信里写的都是心里话。
e2: Everything in this letter comes from the writer's heart.

explanation: The overall attitude with which someone faces a situation.
h1: 比赛前要调整好心态。
e1: Adjust your mental attitude before the match.
h2: 学习时保持开放的心态很有帮助。
e2: An open attitude is helpful when learning.

explanation: A person's preference or desire to act.
h1: 安排活动时要考虑孩子的意愿。
e1: Consider the child's wishes when arranging activities.
h2: 她表达了继续学习的意愿。
e2: She expressed a wish to continue studying.

explanation: The purpose behind an action or message.
h1: 我没有理解他这句话的意图。
e1: I did not understand the intention behind his words.
h2: 先说明意图，可以减少误会。
e2: Explaining your intention first can reduce misunderstandings.

explanation: The reason something is said or done.
h1: 老师这样安排有自己的用意。
e1: The teacher has a reason for arranging it this way.
h2: 我后来才明白她的用意。
e2: I understood her purpose only later.

explanation: What someone originally meant or wanted to do.
h1: 我的本意是帮忙，并不是批评。
e1: My original intention was to help, not criticize.
h2: 请不要误解这句话的本意。
e2: Do not misunderstand the intended meaning of this sentence.

explanation: The meaning intended before it was altered or interpreted.
h1: 翻译要尽量保留原意。
e1: A translation should preserve the original meaning as much as possible.
h2: 转述时不要改变对方的原意。
e2: Do not change someone's original meaning when repeating their words.

explanation: Form an idea without being certain.
h1: 我猜想她可能还在路上。
e1: I suppose she may still be on the way.
h2: 他的猜想后来得到了证实。
e2: His guess was later confirmed.

explanation: A feeling about what may happen before evidence is available.
h1: 她有一种比赛会顺利的预感。
e1: She has a feeling that the match will go smoothly.
h2: 这个预感并没有成为事实。
e2: This premonition did not come true.

explanation: Imagine how something may develop before it happens.
h1: 结果比我预想的好。
e1: The result was better than I had anticipated.
h2: 出发前要预想可能遇到的问题。
e2: Anticipate possible problems before setting out.

explanation: Know relevant facts about a situation.
h1: 她对此并不知情。
e1: She knows nothing about this situation.
h2: 在所有人知情后，我们再做决定。
e2: We will decide after everyone has been informed.

explanation: Feeling proud or satisfied with a success.
h1: 她赢了比赛，笑得很得意。
e1: She won the match and smiled proudly.
h2: 有一点进步也不要太得意。
e2: Do not become too pleased with yourself after a little progress.

explanation: Feeling bothered or unable to settle one's thoughts.
h1: 外面的噪声让我很心烦。
e1: The noise outside is making me annoyed.
h2: 心烦时，她喜欢走出去散步。
e2: She likes going for a walk when she feels troubled.

explanation: Feel bothered by a troublesome matter.
h1: 她为搬家的事情烦心。
e1: She is troubled by the move.
h2: 这是件烦心的事，需要慢慢处理。
e2: This is a troubling matter that needs handling patiently.

english: be in a difficult position; trouble someone
explanation: Face a difficult choice or make a request hard to meet.
h1: 两个邀请同时到来，让她很为难。
e1: Receiving two invitations at once put her in a difficult position.
h2: 如果时间不合适，我不想为难你。
e2: I do not want to trouble you if the time is unsuitable.

explanation: Feeling shy or awkward about a social situation.
h1: 大家突然表扬她，她有些难为情。
e1: She felt a little embarrassed when everyone suddenly praised her.
h2: 弄错朋友的名字让他很难为情。
e2: Getting his friend's name wrong made him embarrassed.

explanation: Feeling unable to handle a situation without support.
h1: 第一次迷路时，他感到很无助。
e1: He felt helpless when he got lost for the first time.
h2: 朋友的陪伴减少了她的无助感。
e2: Her friend's company reduced her feeling of helplessness.

explanation: Lose confidence because of difficulties or setbacks.
h1: 一次失败并没有让她灰心。
e1: One failure did not make her lose heart.
h2: 他有些灰心，但仍愿意再试。
e2: He feels discouraged but is still willing to try again.

explanation: Feeling disappointed after a setback.
h1: 计划取消后，她有些丧气。
e1: She felt downhearted after the plan was canceled.
h2: 别一遇到困难就丧气。
e2: Do not become discouraged at the first difficulty.

explanation: Having a sad and reflective mood.
h1: 这首歌的旋律有些忧郁。
e1: The melody of this song is slightly melancholy.
h2: 她望着窗外，神情忧郁。
e2: She gazed out of the window with a melancholy expression.

explanation: Feel concern about possible difficulties.
h1: 父母对她独自旅行有些忧虑。
e1: Her parents are concerned about her traveling alone.
h2: 他把忧虑写在日记里。
e2: He wrote his worries in his diary.

explanation: Feeling sadness stirred by memories or parting.
h1: 翻看旧照片时，她有些伤感。
e1: She felt sentimental while looking through old photos.
h2: 这首离别的歌让人伤感。
e2: This song about parting makes people feel sad.

explanation: A bad circumstance or unhappy event.
h1: 他把这次不幸当作重新开始的机会。
e1: He treated this misfortune as a chance to start again.
h2: 这个故事讲述了一个不幸的家庭。
e2: This story tells of an unfortunate family.

explanation: Reacting mainly through immediate feelings rather than steady judgment.
h1: 她发现自己疲惫时容易情绪化。
e1: She notices that she becomes more emotional when tired.
h2: 讨论重要事情时，他尽量不情绪化。
e2: He tries not to react emotionally when discussing important matters.

explanation: Easily affected by feelings or delicate matters.
h1: 他对别人的批评很敏感。
e1: He is sensitive to criticism from others.
h2: 这是一个敏感的话题，需要谨慎表达。
e2: This is a sensitive topic that needs careful wording.

explanation: Lacking energy or interest.
h1: 今天走了很久，她觉得浑身没劲。
e1: After a long walk today, she feels exhausted.
h2: 这个重复的游戏有点没劲。
e2: This repetitive game is a little boring.

explanation: Experience physical or emotional comfort.
h1: 听到朋友的安慰后，我好受多了。
e1: I felt much better after my friend's comforting words.
h2: 被误解的感觉并不好受。
e2: Being misunderstood does not feel good.

explanation: Get through a situation with less difficulty or discomfort.
h1: 有人分担工作，日子就好过一些。
e1: Life is easier when someone shares the work.
h2: 经历离别以后，她并不好过。
e2: She has had a difficult time since the separation.

explanation: Extremely sad because of a painful emotional experience.
h1: 失去陪伴多年的宠物让她心碎。
e1: Losing her longtime pet left her heartbroken.
h2: 这个离别的故事听得他心碎。
e2: This story of parting broke his heart.

explanation: Easily moved by pity or affection.
h1: 看到孩子难过，她又心软了。
e1: She softened again when she saw the child upset.
h2: 他心软，不忍拒绝朋友的请求。
e2: He is softhearted and cannot bear to refuse his friend's request.

explanation: Eager for something to happen without delay.
h1: 等了很久，他开始心急。
e1: He became impatient after waiting a long time.
h2: 题目难时不要心急，慢慢读。
e2: Do not rush when a problem is difficult; read it slowly.

english: feel protective concern; feel sorry for
explanation: Feel distress over someone's suffering or something valued.
h1: 看见孩子受伤，妈妈很心疼。
e1: The mother felt distressed to see her child hurt.
h2: 她心疼奶奶每天辛苦做饭。
e2: She feels for her grandmother, who works hard cooking every day.

explanation: Loved and valued very much.
h1: 她修好了心爱的旧玩具。
e1: She repaired her cherished old toy.
h2: 他把心爱的书送给了朋友。
e2: He gave his beloved book to a friend.

explanation: Feel positive affection or enjoyment toward something.
h1: 孩子们喜爱这位耐心的老师。
e1: The children are fond of this patient teacher.
h2: 她喜爱安静的阅读环境。
e2: She likes a quiet reading environment.

explanation: The things or activities a person tends to enjoy.
h1: 每个人的喜好都不同。
e1: Everyone has different preferences.
h2: 送礼前可以了解对方的喜好。
e2: Learn about the other person's preferences before choosing a gift.

explanation: Feeling pleased at good news or success.
h1: 看到进步，她感到欣喜。
e1: She felt delighted to see her progress.
h2: 他的到来让家人十分欣喜。
e2: His arrival delighted his family.

explanation: Feeling glad or pleased.
h1: 收到朋友的信，她满心欢喜。
e1: She was full of joy when she received her friend's letter.
h2: 孩子们欢喜地迎接新老师。
e2: The children happily welcomed the new teacher.

explanation: Laugh with happiness.
h1: 公园里传来孩子们的欢笑。
e1: The sound of children laughing joyfully came from the park.
h2: 一家人围着桌子欢笑。
e2: The family laughed happily around the table.

explanation: The sound produced when people laugh.
h1: 教室里响起了笑声。
e1: Laughter filled the classroom.
h2: 远处的笑声让她也放松下来。
e2: The laughter in the distance helped her relax too.

explanation: Smile or laugh in a silly, unrestrained way.
h1: 想到那件趣事，他忍不住傻笑。
e1: He could not help grinning at the thought of that amusing incident.
h2: 她看着旧照片，一个人傻笑。
e2: She giggled to herself while looking at old photos.

explanation: Begin to laugh at something.
h1: 这个小故事让大家发笑。
e1: This short story made everyone laugh.
h2: 他尽量不发笑，认真听她说完。
e2: He tried not to laugh and listened seriously until she finished.

explanation: Cause someone to laugh through something amusing.
h1: 哥哥用一个故事逗笑了妹妹。
e1: The older brother made his sister laugh with a story.
h2: 这张有趣的照片把我逗笑了。
e2: This amusing photo made me laugh.

explanation: Entertain someone through humor or play.
h1: 他做了个鬼脸，把孩子逗乐了。
e1: He pulled a funny face and amused the child.
h2: 这个节目常常把观众逗乐。
e2: This program often entertains the audience.

explanation: Begin to show anger.
h1: 他听到谎话后发怒了。
e1: He became angry after hearing the lie.
h2: 她没有发怒，而是先问清原因。
e2: She did not get angry and first asked what had happened.

explanation: Feeling anger caused by an irritating problem.
h1: 反复的噪声让她很恼怒。
e1: The repeated noise made her irritated.
h2: 他压下恼怒，重新解释了一遍。
e2: He held back his annoyance and explained again.

explanation: Cause another person to become irritated.
h1: 他的玩笑惹恼了同桌。
e1: His joke annoyed his desk mate.
h2: 不停打断别人容易惹恼对方。
e2: Constantly interrupting someone can annoy them.

explanation: Attentive to another person's needs.
h1: 她准备热茶的举动很贴心。
e1: It was thoughtful of her to prepare hot tea.
h2: 这份贴心的提醒让我少走了弯路。
e2: This considerate reminder saved me unnecessary trouble.

explanation: Give careful attention to an activity or person.
h1: 她用心准备了这堂课。
e1: She put care into preparing this lesson.
h2: 礼物不必昂贵，重要的是用心。
e2: A gift need not be expensive; what matters is the thought behind it.

explanation: Real affection or sincere emotion.
h1: 这封信表达了她的真情。
e1: This letter expresses her genuine feelings.
h2: 真情不一定需要华丽的语言。
e2: Genuine emotion does not require elaborate language.

explanation: Strong and enduring affection.
h1: 她深情地望着多年未见的家人。
e1: She looked with deep affection at relatives she had not seen for years.
h2: 这首歌表达了对家乡的深情。
e2: This song expresses deep affection for the singer's hometown.
